PRIVACY

Your video stays yours.

Yerp processes your video entirely in your browser. The selected video and finished GIF are not uploaded to Yerp or stored on a server.

What Yerp accesses

Only the video you explicitly choose. Your browser grants temporary access so the page can decode frames and build your GIF locally.

What Yerp stores

Nothing from your video. Refreshing or closing the page clears the working session. A downloaded GIF is saved only where you choose on your device.

Analytics and cookies

This version of Yerp does not set advertising cookies, create accounts, or use analytics to identify you.

Questions

Use the feedback page for privacy questions.
